mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_users (id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, last_login_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenant.id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.status AS user_status, u.last_login_at, u.version AS user_version, u.created_at AS user_created_at, u.updated_at AS user_updated_at, t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, t.status AS tenant_status, t.created_at AS tenant_created_at, t.updated_at AS tenant_updated_at FROM iam_users u JOIN tenants t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.status AS user_status, u.last_login_at, u.version AS user_version, u.created_at AS user_created_at, u.updated_at AS user_updated_at, t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, t.status AS tenant_status, t.created_at AS tenant_created_at, t.updated_at AS tenant_updated_at FROM iam_users u JOIN tenants t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
